description: This file contains unit tests for the TalkModeConfigParsing component of the OpenClaw project, testing parsing logic and default value handling for talk provider configurations.

classes.name: TalkModeConfigParsingTests
classes.description: A test suite containing multiple test cases for parsing and validating talk mode configurations.

methods.name: `rejects normalized talk provider payload without resolved`
methods.description: Tests that payloads without the 'resolved' field are rejected.

methods.name: `falls back to legacy talk fields when normalized payload missing`
methods.description: Ensures fallback logic to legacy fields operates correctly when normalized payload is absent.

methods.name: `reads configured silence timeout ms`
methods.description: Verifies that configured silence timeout is correctly read from input.

methods.name: `defaults silence timeout ms when missing`
methods.description: Checks that default silence timeout is used when the configuration is missing.

methods.name: `defaults silence timeout ms when invalid`
methods.description: Ensures the default timeout is used when an invalid value is provided.
